image_title: Transformer Performance in English Constituency Parsing
summary: This table presents the performance of various parsers on English constituency parsing, specifically focusing on the Wall Street Journal (WSJ) dataset. It compares different training methods, including discriminative and semi-supervised approaches, across several models. The F1 scores for the WSJ 23 dataset are listed, highlighting the Transformer model's superior performance with a score of 93.3 under generative training, surpassing other models such as the Berkeley Parser and RNN sequence-to-sequence models. The data indicates that task-specific tuning significantly enhances model performance, with the Transformer consistently yielding better results than previous architectures.
